has_next.description: Whether or not the list of labeling results has reached the end.

last_sequence_id.description: If has_next is true, the last_sequence_id is the token that should accompany the next request to get the following page of results.

limit.description: The maximum number of labeling results to retrieve per page.

origin.description: An identifier for the file origin of the content.

series.description: An identifier for the series that the content belongs to.

series_index.description: The index of the content within the series (if any) that it belongs to.

dicom_study_uid.description: The DICOM study UID of the content.

dicom_series_uid.description: The DICOM series UID of the content.

dicom_instance_uid.description: The DICOM instance UID of the content.

task_type.description: The labeling task (e.g. choice, box, circle, etc.)

patch.description: An identifier for the patch within the image to be labeled.

labeling_state.description: The labeling state of the case (e.g. Labeled, Gold Standard, etc.)

qualified_reads.description: The number of qualified reads collected for the case.

portal_url.description: URL to access view case in the Centaur portal.

comments.description: Comments submitted by users on the case.

flags.description: Messages submitted by users who flagged the case.

content_id.description: An identifier for the content to which these results apply. If the case involves multiple content IDs, the lowest content ID is given.

correct_label.description: The correct label for the case.  If the case is a segmentation task, then the contained strings will be in WKT format.

majority_label.description: The majority label for the case based on user opinions.  If the case is a segmentation task, then the contained strings will be in WKT format.

agreement.description: The agreement between user opinions on the case.

read_stats.description: Read statistics for user opinions on the case.  Only included for classification tasks.

counts.description: Vote count breakdown by label category for user opinions on the case.

weights.description: Confidence level by label category for user opinions on the case.

top_reads.description: The list of top user opinions used to create the majority label for the case.  Only included for segmentation tasks.

read_id.description: An identifier for the user opinion.

user_id.description: The ID of the user who submitted the opinion.

accuracy.description: The confidence level of the user opinion.
